question.text: In Indian Cat III AIF market, the '2-20' fee structure means:

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 3.3.8, '2-20' = 2% management fee + 20% additional return (performance fee). The Trap: The two numbers refer to mgmt and performance fees respectively. Cross-Exam Context: Common hedge fund fee shorthand; not always standard in India. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Confirm actual fee schedule — many Indian AIFs diverge from 2-20.
